abilities.desc_zh: 如果具有不可阻挡增益的对手冲向狂飙，他会立即获得黑暗能量，使不可阻挡增益无效，并造成 {{var_6}} 眩晕。
abilities.desc_en: If an opponent with an Unstoppable buff Dashes toward Cyclonus, he instantly gains Dark Energy, Nullifies the Unstoppable buff, and inflicts Stun for {{var_6}}.
